children: Grades broadly fell on Monday, dealers said, as prices normalized somewhat after the end of the volatile roll trading period, used by traders to square positions, adjust slates and net out any exposure, often leading to price spikes and dips.

Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said on Monday they had attacked Saudi Arabia's East-West crude oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport, as rising hostilities choke oil supplies and threaten to erupt into a larger conflict.

The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said earlier it had destroyed two ballistic missile launchers in the capital Sanaa, including one used to fire a missile towards Riyadh that the coalition said it had intercepted.

October has been the worst month for attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and nearby waterways, according to data compiled by a Washington-based think tank that has tracked maritime security incidents worldwide since 2017.
Around a fifth of global oil and gas supplies were flowing through the strait before the Iran war broke out in February.
Light Louisiana Sweet (WTC-LLS) for December delivery fell $2.90 to a midpoint of a $4 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $3 and $5 a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
Mars Sour (WTC-MRS) fell $6.50 to a midpoint of a $2.50 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $2.40 and $2.60 a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
WTI Midland  (WTC-WTM) fell 85 cents to a midpoint of a 60-cent premium and was seen bid and offered between a 50-cent and 70-cent a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
West Texas Sour (WTC-WTS) rose $1.48 to a midpoint of a $1.60 discount and was seen bid and offered between a $1.70 and $1.50 a barrel discount to U.S. crude futures
WTI at East Houston (WTC-MEH), also known as MEH, traded between a $1.05 and $1.25 a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
fell 91 cents to settle at $115.81 a barrel on Monday​.
futures fell $1.51 to settle at $101.76 a barrel on Monday​.
The Brent/WTI spread (WTCLc1-LCOc1) widened 59 cents to last trade at minus $14.04, after hitting a high of minus $13.30 and a low of minus $14.36.
